165:t_1:5.en:
$$カムラン$$
「Funds are still flowing out for unknown purposes. As suspected, many colonies seem to be secretly supporting $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

165:t_1:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So this flow won't stop...」

165:t_1:7.en:
$$カムラン$$
「I'll continue sending you the information I gather.」

165:t_1:9.en:
$$カムラン$$
「I'm doing this because I want $$ミライ$$ to stay alive.」

165:t_1:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As her former fiance, you have every right to say that.」

165:t_1:11.en:
$$カムラン$$
「Thank you, Captain $$ブライト$$. Then...」

165:t_1:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
(All sorts of people are supporting us from their own positions... But...)

165:t_1:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Where is the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ now?」

165:t_1:14.en:
$$メラン$$
「It's still some distance away. The rendezvous will take time.」

165:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But we were fortunate that $$バナージ$$ and the others reached space close to us.」

165:t_1:16.en:
$$ブライト$$
「When $$レディ・アン$$ contacted me, I honestly thanked our good fortune.」

165:t_1:17.en:
$$メラン$$
「Perhaps you drew them here, Captain?」

165:t_1:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Stop joking. Don't make me sound like bait for $$ガンダム$$s.」

165:t_1:19.en:
$$クェス$$
「But everyone says that's the kind of person you are, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

165:t_1:20.en:
$$クェス$$
「They say Captain $$ブライト$$ is the dad of all the $$ガンダム$$ pilots.」

165:t_1:21.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$クェス$$...! You've sneaked onto the bridge again!」

165:t_1:22.en:
$$クェス$$
「Don't worry about it, Major $$コンロイ$$. This is $$ロンド・ベル$$, after all.」

165:t_1:23.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「...Well, that's true. We're fighting alongside the $$赤い彗星$$... Anything goes now.」

165:t_1:25.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「He's with $$ミネバ・ザビ$$.」

165:t_1:26.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I suppose we can leave her to him... Where are $$バナージ$$ and $$リディ$$?」

165:t_1:27.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Both are shut up in their respective rooms. Captain $$ナイジェル$$ plans to question Ensign $$リディ$$.」

165:t_1:29.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're going to see $$バナージ$$ yourself, Captain? That's the $$ガンダム$$ pilots' dad for you!」

165:t_1:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't tease me, $$クェス$$. $$ハサウェイ$$ is enough of a handful as a son.」

165:t_1:31.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then could you handle a daughter?」

165:t_1:33.en:
$$クェス$$
「If I marry $$ハサウェイ$$, you'll be my papa, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

165:t_1:40.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「...I understand what's happened since you were assigned to $$オーブ$$. I'll report it to the higher-ups.」

165:t_1:44.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「A pilot in that state will only die on the battlefield. Get out of the service and go carry bags for your senator.」

165:t_1:46.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Then lift your head. Living as a pilot is your only option now.」

165:t_1:47.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「That was what you wanted in the first place, wasn't it?」

165:t_1:49.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「On the battlefield, old and young, rich and poor, men and women are equal. Everyone stands on the line between life and death.」

165:t_1:50.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Don't think about anything else. Live more simply.」

165:t_1:52.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Someone like me can't understand the burden your family carries...」

165:t_1:53.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「But I believe I know you as an individual pilot.」

165:t_1:55.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「At least, since you were assigned to $$ロンド・ベル$$, I've never treated you as the $$マーセナス家$$'s pampered son.」

165:t_1:56.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I recommended you for the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s mobile suit team because I thought your abilities suited it.」

165:t_1:58.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「That's all I can say. If you don't want to die, live with everything you've got.」

165:t_1:59.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Your machine will surely respond to that.」

165:t_1:65.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I've made $$ブライト$$ go to some trouble. He's even letting us use the captain's quarters...」

165:t_1:66.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...You're still fighting for the $$スペースノイド$$s, $$シャア$$.」

165:t_1:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「There is no distinction between $$スペースノイド$$s and $$アースノイド$$s. I'm fighting for humanity... or so I believe.」

165:t_1:68.en:
$$シャア$$
「But there's a limit to what I can do now that I've stepped down as $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s leader.」

165:t_1:70.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, there are people willing to lend me their strength, $$ナナイ$$ among them.」

165:t_1:71.en:
$$シャア$$
「Most of them object to $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current methods.」

165:t_1:72.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「They're cozying up to $$サイデリアル$$ to save themselves...」

165:t_1:73.en:
$$シャア$$
「...From one perspective, you could call that right.」

165:t_1:75.en:
$$シャア$$
「If the aim is to keep people alive, whatever form that takes, it's one possible choice.」

165:t_1:76.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It's an act of abandoning human dignity.」

165:t_1:77.en:
$$シャア$$
「But our opponents are powerful and wouldn't even hesitate to wipe out humanity.」

165:t_1:79.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「No future awaits those who abandon possibility and choose the easy path before them.」

165:t_1:80.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I'm glad I entrusted you to $c.」

165:t_1:82.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'm going to see the young man who broadened your possibilities.」

165:t_1:84.en:
$$シャア$$
「He's different from both $$アムロ$$ and $$カミーユ$$... I sense something else in him... a new possibility...」

165:t_1:86.en:
$$シャア$$
「When things settle down, I'd like to hear your violin again. May I ask that of you, $$ミネバ$$?」
